title: Directed reachability language
statement: Let $\mathrm{PATH}$ be the language of Boolean strings that are the encoding of some directed graph on $n$ vertices together with two vertices $s,t$, for some natural number $n$, where $t$ is reachable from $s$ in that graph by a finite directed walk, possibly of length zero.
caveat: The language is defined through the encoding operation pairEncode, whose convention is not given in the supplied snippet.
